title: an Orca call that does not answer is given up after 10 s: graph --json prints the rest of the snapshot with a notice that says so and exits 3
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, release 2 of the communication plan
intent: A hung orca must not freeze the view. Only graph gives its Orca calls a time limit; launch, close and reap wait as before.

stdout.contains:
"orca": true,
  "notices": [
    "Orca did not answer in time (orchestration inbox): only the synapses recorded with jitso link are shown."
  ],

stderr.equals: jitso: orca orchestration inbox did not answer within 10 s
